items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Well, I had gotten to know Coleman Hawkins, you know, very briefly

ctx.x: What was the show? Was it dancers, singers?

Dancing, singing, you know, comedy. You know, the regular old-time vaudeville that used to come on after the pictures. This is when I was...I was 15 or 16 then. That's when I first met Art Tatum. There was a place called Jimmy Owens, 49th and Central in Cleveland, which was down the street from the Majestic Hotel. The Majestic Hotel is where all the musicians used to stay. That's where I first heard Coleman Hawkins when he was with Fletcher Henderson's band, and that's where I met Roy Eldridge. Roy was 19, and I…

But that's where I first heard Art Tatum. Art Tatum, I remember, was 23 at the time, and I used to go up into this... It was just a joint, you know. And I used to go up there and sit down in a corner by myself, and just listen.
